name: Ukulele
group: Things people make > Toys > Make music with it > Pluck or strum strings

features.claim: A ukulele has a figure-eight body shape like a small acoustic guitar.
features.quote: Typically, ukuleles have a figure-eight body shape similar to that of a small acoustic guitar.

features.claim: A ukulele usually has four strings.
features.quote: These instruments usually have four strings; some strings may be paired in courses, giving the instrument a total of six or eight strings (primarily for greater strumming volume.)

features.claim: A ukulele has 16 to 22 frets, depending on its size.
features.quote: They have 16–22 frets depending on the size.

features.claim: A ukulele is generally made of wood.
features.quote: The ukulele is generally made of wood, though variants have been composed partially or entirely of plastic or other materials.

features.claim: A ukulele is a small instrument with four strings.
features.quote: The ukulele (pronounced /ˌjʉːkəˈlɛɪli/ from the Hawaiian ʻukulele, pronounced /ˈʔukuˈlɛlɛ/) is a musical instrument with four strings.

second_reading.claim: The strings of a ukulele are made of nylon or similar synthetic materials.
second_reading.quote: Modern ukuleles use strings made from nylon polymers, synthetic gut, or fluorocarbon or wound strings composed of a (typically) nylon core wound with metal or polymers, including aluminium and silver-plated copper.
